And you may notice your mind wandering... drifting back toward the surface... And if a piece of you has floated up toward the light... do not chase it. Let it go. And perhaps a thought or two has slipped its leash... tugging you toward the shallows...
That's alright. Just drift...
Sissy Drop.
Sink back down... deeper and deeper... right back where you belong. That's it. Down you come, all of you... faster this time... all the way back to the bottom. All the way back down... deeper than you left it... good girl.
